{"notes": "Visit 2 (left at 2:45). Still don't know who placed which dominoes; ratings rest on claims plus the picture.

Sofia: Her 2:30 status was accurate: the chain connects from the nose round both sides to the tail. She flagged that the fin ends are still open, named who is laying them, and plans a final check, which is good coordination and leadership. Her 'open ends' wording is slightly loose, since Jack's side looks connected. She is mostly coordinating, so I can't see her hands-on contribution. Ask what she is laying herself, and whether she has noticed Hana's gap.

Omar: Strong. He went from 17/38 at 1:30 to a bottom line that is fully connected and crossing the tail by 2:15, matching what he told me. His public and private reports agree. He plans to inspect the tail joint and the nose split, which are sensible weak spots. The joint looks connected in the picture. He removed the bottleneck. Good execution, reliable reporting.

Hana: Still said nothing to me in two visits. Her top tail half is dark up to about (26, 5.8), then a pale, unconnected curl runs round to her hands at (27.2, 9.7). There is a gap at the join, so her section isn't attached to the chain. Possible risk to the whole tail. Her output is visible but unverified, and her communication is weak. Check next visit whether she closes the gap, and ask her directly.

Jack: His bottom tail half is laid and connected, reaching (27, 14.3), so he started once Omar finished. He didn't speak this visit. Execution looks solid. Ask whether he can help Hana close her gap.

Team: Everything except Hana's section is connected. Next visit, check the gap and the final joins."}
